query: What patient needs appear in visit notes?

per_column.name: clinical_domain
per_column.rationale: Provides a clinical grouping axis beyond raw department, useful for aggregating patient needs. Values are well-grounded (dermatology labeled Specialty_Surgical is a slight stretch but defensible as a categorization scheme). Partially derivable from existing department column but adds a coarser clinical lens.

per_column.name: presenting_problem_family
per_column.rationale: Directly addresses the query about patient needs by categorizing the presenting problem. Values are sound readings of the reason_for_visit text (viral URI as Symptom_Evaluation, knee twist as Injury_or_Trauma). Strong new grouping axis.

per_column.name: intervention_scope
per_column.rationale: Captures what care was delivered/needed, a genuine axis for analyzing needs. Values largely warranted from text (labs->Diagnostic, adapalene+doxycycline->Medication_Adjustment). MI follow-up 'continue regimen' as Medication_Adjustment is a mild overreach but defensible.

per_column.name: care_continuity_type
per_column.rationale: Distinguishes new vs follow-up vs preventive care, a useful modeling axis not present in originals. Values well-grounded (post-MI follow-up correctly Post_Intervention_Follow_Up; acne as new problem correct).

per_column.name: severity_or_acuity_signal
per_column.rationale: Adds an acuity dimension beyond the original urgency column, though partially correlated with it. Values are sound readings (stable post-MI as Stable_Routine, acute knee injury as Acute_Unstable). Some redundancy with urgency limits leverage slightly.

judge.rationale: The added columns collectively provide multiple genuine, non-trivial axes (problem family, intervention, continuity, acuity, domain) for analyzing patient needs from visit notes, directly serving the query. None are near-constant or mere restatements, though severity and domain partially overlap existing urgency/department columns. Produced values are consistently sound categorizations of the source reason_for_visit text with no invented facts observed; occasional labels (dermatology as Specialty_Surgical, stable regimen as Medication_Adjustment) are mild stretches within a defensible scheme rather than hallucinations.
